children.name: Geocaulon lividum  Fernald
children.description: The only species of the monotypic genus Geocaulon (northern comandra or false toadflax), a perennial hemiparasitic herb growing from rhizomes to 30 cm tall. Its inflorescences bear two or three greenish or purplish flowers and a one-seeded orange drupe; via haustoria it taps the roots of spruce, pine, birch, willow and other hosts. Native to northern North America from Alaska to Newfoundland, in moist boreal forests, bogs and wetlands.
